recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-14541 unless a future terminology-service decision changes the CodeSystem $validate-code operation itself.
issue_request: FHIR-14541 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab change request from STU3 asking to add the new CodeSystem $validate-code operation to the Terminology Module.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the issue was applied in svn 13359. Git-svn commit 9c32d3b1c90a34bfad894cf6d2237409525b4a0b, corresponding to SVN build@13359, added the CodeSystem $validate-code link to source/terminology-module.html under CodeSystem operations.
additional_context: The current build still carries the requested operation. source/hierarchy.xml includes terminology-module.html as the active Terminology module page and the CodeSystem resource page under that module; source/fhir.ini lists codesystem as an active Vocab resource; source/codesystem/list-CodeSystem-operations.xml references OperationDefinition/CodeSystem-validate-code; and source/codesystem/operationdefinition-CodeSystem-validate-code.xml defines the CodeSystem validate-code operation. Confluence block-vote evidence matches the Jira disposition, and community searches did not find conflicting human discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the requested Terminology Module link and the underlying CodeSystem operation definition are already present on the current combined branch.
